name: Hazel Rose
source:
The year is 1985. The location is a secret. 

Hazel Rose has been trapped in the dark for as long as she can remember until the day the light turned on.  What she soon sees leaves her wishing it was dark again.

Can Hazel escape from her captor and survive the strange horrors in the mansion? Or will she succumb to the will of the cult?

[From [url=https://margie-winters.itch.io/hazel-rose]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
时间是1985年，地点是一个秘密。

从Hazel Rose记事起，她就一直被困在黑暗中，直到灯亮起的那一天。她很快看到的一切让她希望天又黑了。

海兹尔能否逃脱绑架者并在宅邸中的奇怪恐怖中幸存下来？或者她会屈服于邪教的意志吗？

[来自[url=https://margie-winters.itch.io/hazel-rose]Itch.io[/url]]
